intro: Spain is a football giant, home to Real Madrid and Barcelona, and has produced champions in tennis, basketball, cycling and motor racing.

chapters.title: Football
text: Spain's men won the World Cup in 2010 and have won the European Championship a record four times, in 1964, 2008, 2012 and 2024. Its women won the World Cup in 2023, and Aitana Bonmatí won the Ballon d'Or three years running from 2023.

Real Madrid has won the Champions League more times than any other club, and its matches against Barcelona, El Clásico, are watched around the world. Spain co-hosts the 2030 World Cup with Portugal and Morocco.

chapters.title: Tennis and more
text: Rafael Nadal won 22 Grand Slam titles, including a record 14 French Opens, and Carlos Alcaraz has become one of the world's best players. Spain's basketball team, led by Pau Gasol, won the World Cup in 2006 and 2019.
Miguel Induráin won the Tour de France five times in a row, Fernando Alonso won two Formula One titles, and Marc Márquez is a multiple MotoGP world champion. Barcelona hosted the 1992 Olympics.
